name: An Aggressive Defense
summary: Raene Wolfrunner sends Alliance defenders against the Foulweald furbolgs in Ashenvale. Corruption has made the tribe dangerous along the road east of Astranaar.

sections.title: Threat to the Highway
sections.body: Furbolgs now attack travelers on the road east from Astranaar toward the Falfarren River. Sentinel Raene Wolfrunner sends capable defenders to strike the Foulweald camps just south of the highway. The attacks have made this vital road through Ashenvale dangerous for anyone who travels it.

sections.title: A Bitter History
sections.body: The Foulweald were once friends and allies of the night elves. For ages, the kaldorei and furbolgs shared a reverence for nature and the wild gods. The Burning Legion's invasion left a taint that shattered many furbolg minds. Peaceful neighbors became violent reavers, and innocent travelers now face their attacks.

faq.q: Who offers this task and where are they located?
faq.answer: Sentinel Raene Wolfrunner offers the defense from Astranaar, the principal night elf settlement in central Ashenvale.

faq.q: Why are the furbolgs in Ashenvale hostile?
faq.answer: The Foulweald fell to demonic taint left by the Burning Legion during the Third War. Their minds turned violent, driving them to attack travelers and former allies.

faq.q: Where are the Foulweald camps found?
faq.answer: The Foulweald camps lie south of the main road east from Astranaar, west of the Falfarren River.

faq.q: Were the furbolgs always enemies of the night elves?
faq.answer: No. Furbolgs and night elves lived side by side in harmony for thousands of years. Demonic corruption in Ashenvale and Felwood drove tribes like the Foulweald to hostility.

faq.q: Does this quest connect to other events in Astranaar?
faq.answer: Raene's strike is one part of Astranaar's defense. She also directs defenders to investigate corrupted moonwells and help cleanse the forest.

faq.q: What specific furbolgs must be eliminated?
faq.answer: Raene calls for one Foulweald Den Watcher, two Ursas, ten Totemics, and twelve Warriors to be slain, breaking the tribe's command near the road.

angles.text: As a kaldorei, you face the grim need to fight former forest kin whose minds corruption has taken.
As an Alliance defender, you help keep the road from Astranaar to eastern outposts clear for supplies and travelers.
As a druid, you see the Foulweald's madness as a warning of fel taint in Kalimdor's sacred wild places.
